_comment: Only things that must be MEASURED live here.
The ctest and pybind inventories used to be pinned in this file and went stale twice
in three weeks. check_ctest.py now derives both from the CMakeLists that registers
them, so they are deliberately absent.
tests/python_api/image_comparison.py exits non-zero since #616, so the exit code is
now a real signal - but only for 'did anything fail', which is always true while
known failures exist. The set below is what distinguishes the SAME known failures
from a different set of the same size.
Names are golden filenames with '.png' and the '_host'/'_hip' suffix stripped.
These failures are KNOWN, NOT root-caused and NOT accepted; the report repeats that
every run so they do not quietly become permanent.
Re-measure rather than re-derive. The previous 139/19 baseline was patched on paper
to an expected 129 after #587 disabled ten cases; the measured total is 151, because
develop also ADDED cases (Posterize, Solarize, LUT, JpegCompressionDistortion ...).
Arithmetic on a baseline produces a number that looks authoritative and is wrong.
python_api.measured_against: add-rocal-validate-skill @ ab63879b (develop merged), gfx1100, ROCm 7.16.26314, built from source and run against build/lib

host.note: 5 of these 9 are NOT pixel mismatches - MIVisionX-data has no reference image for them, and image_comparison.py counts a missing golden as a failure. Only ColorTemp_rgb, GaussianFilter_{gray,rgb} and Hue_rgb actually compared and differed. Goldens are per-backend (the filename carries _host/_hip), which is why a name can lack a golden on one backend and have one on the other.

hip.note: 152 vs host's 151 is expected: #629 disables the WarpPerspective HOST case only, so hip still runs it - and it fails, which is what #629 was filed for. 2 of these 10 are missing goldens rather than mismatches.

audio._comment: Only runs when the build reports AUDIO_SUPPORT. audio_unit_test.py prints 'Number of FAILED tests: N'.
